title: The completion of a direct sum of copies of a Noetherian ring is flat
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter more-algebra.tex (More on Algebra)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-algebra.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that the completion of an arbitrary direct sum of copies of a Noetherian ring is flat over the ring. The proof first replaces the ring by its completion, which is legitimate because the completion map is flat and because the completion of the direct sum does not change under that replacement. In the complete case the author invokes the comparison map from the completed direct sum to the product, which is universally injective, so flatness of the target follows from flatness of the completed direct sum; flatness of the product of copies is then read off from the cohomological characterisation of coherent rings plus Noetherianity.
